name: Cult
description: Zealots devoted to a strange and secret power.

typeUpgrades.name: Cult Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: You get 2 free load in two of the equipment categories (weapons, implements, supplies, gear, documents, and tools).

typeUpgrades.name: Ritual Sanctum
typeUpgrades.description: Your lair includes a sanctum for performing rituals.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Adepts
typeUpgrades.description: Your Adepts cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Thugs
typeUpgrades.description: Your Thugs cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Ordained
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 trauma box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Chosen
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Attune, Study, or Sway (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Anointed
features.description: You gain +1d to resistance rolls against supernatural threats. You get +1d to healing rolls when you have supernatural harm.

features.name: Bound in Darkness
features.description: You may perform teamwork with any cult member, regardless of distance. Take 1 stress to have a whispered message heard by every cultist.

features.name: Conviction
features.description: Each PC gains an extra vice: Worship. When you indulge this vice (with sacrifice), you avoid overindulgence, and your deity assists you with one action roll until your next indulgence.

features.name: Sealed in Blood
features.description: When you perform a human sacrifice, take -3 stress cost for any ritual you perform.

features.name: Zealotry
features.description: Your cohorts get +1d vs. enemies of the faith, and will undertake any service you ask of them.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
